domain: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information

concepts.name: Graphical Excellence
concepts.description: The well-designed presentation of interesting data—a matter of substance, statistics, and design.

concepts.name: Graphical Integrity
concepts.description: Telling the truth about the data, ensuring representations are proportional to the quantities.

sub_concepts.name: Lie Factor
sub_concepts.description: The size of an effect shown in graphic divided by the size of the effect in data.

concepts.name: Data-Ink
concepts.description: The non-erasable core of a graphic, the non-redundant ink arranged in response to variation in the numbers represented.

sub_concepts.name: Data-Ink Ratio
sub_concepts.description: The proportion of a graphic's ink devoted to the non-redundant display of data-information.

concepts.name: Chartjunk
concepts.description: The excessive and unnecessary use of graphical effects in graphs.

sub_concepts.name: Moiré Effects (Vibrations)
sub_concepts.description: Visual distraction caused by optical art patterns.

sub_concepts.name: The Grid
sub_concepts.description: Heavy grid lines that compete with the data.

sub_concepts.name: The Duck
sub_concepts.description: When a graphic is taken over by decorative forms or computer debris.

concepts.name: Data Density
concepts.description: The proportion of the total size of the graph that is dedicated to displaying data.

concepts.name: Small Multiples
concepts.description: Series of graphics showing the same combination of variables, indexed by changes in another variable.

concepts.name: Multifunctioning Graphical Elements
concepts.description: Graphical elements that convey multiple pieces of information simultaneously.

concepts.name: Relational Graphics
concepts.description: Graphics that link at least two variables.

concepts.name: Time-Series Displays
concepts.description: Graphics that show data ordered by time.

concepts.name: Space-Time Narrative Designs
concepts.description: Graphics that represent spatial relationships over time.
